## Overview

This week we visualise probability distributions and learn how to compare groups statistically. We look at the normal distribution, confidence intervals, and how to use density plots and boxplots to explore whether differences between groups are meaningful.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `05-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [05-content.zip](/files/projects/05-content.zip)
